name: Boys & Girls Clubs of Central Virginia (teens)
org: Boys & Girls Clubs of Central Virginia
what_you_do: Join a Club after school or in summer. The home page says teens hold Keystone Club officer roles at Southwood, take part in Youth of the Year, and Southwood runs UpNext, a work-based learning program.
who_can_apply: Children and teens ages 5 to 18. The page does not list residency rules.
pay_detail: Low membership dues, amount not stated. UpNext pay is not stated.
duration: Ongoing; open after school and all day in summer
how_to_apply: Fill out a member form in the online member portal. It is linked from the Membership page. Phone 434-971-9400 or email admin@bgclubcva.org.
notes: There are six clubs: Albemarle Campus, Cherry Avenue, James River, Madison, Orange and Southwood. UpNext is named only on the home page. Ask the Southwood Club how to join and what it pays.
